from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        sm = operator.SharedMemory(llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SKYSCRAPER_SHARED_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SKYSCRAPER_SHARED_AGG)
        draft = await sm(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.SKYSCRAPER_VERIFY_STEP1 + "\n\n{problem}\n\nCandidate:\n{previous_output}", prompt_custom.SKYSCRAPER_VERIFY_STEP2 + "\n\n{problem}\n\nDraft:\n{previous_output}"])
        solution = await seq(draft["response"])
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() if self.aggregator_llm is not self.llm else {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        return solution["response"], {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}

You are solving a Skyscraper puzzle collaboratively through a shared document.

Goal:
- Contribute useful deductions, candidate rows/columns, and consistency checks.

5. Write concise notes only.

Shared document so far:
{document}

Round: {round}
Agent: {agent_id}

{problem}
